name: Ask agent polish: inline citations and feature cards
objective:
Fix two operator-reported defects on the AI 질문 surface. (1) Citation chips break the prose: InlineCitation's always-mounted .quoteWrap is display:grid — a block box in

's inline flow — so every chip forces a line break and a sentence resting on two or more 근거 renders as 「…입니다.[1] ⏎ [2] ⏎ [3]」. Re-cut the ask chip onto the conditionally-mounted absolute-popover anatomy components/Citation.tsx already ships (R10), so chips follow the sentence's period inline and adjacent chips sit side by side — across all three signed placements (프로즈 · 데이터 행 값 · 계산 입력), on the page and the widget, at desktop and ≤767. Server-side numbering is correct and is not touched. (2) The four hard-coded START_CHIPS_KO cards are all read-a-filing questions, exercising only search_events/get_event and leaving calculate, get_portfolio, save_feedback and get_contact invisible. Replace them with a card set — count freed from D11's 'exactly four' by operator instruction — chosen so that clicking the cards one at a time demonstrates every agent capability, keeping R16's layout and the 'card sentence is the question sent' rule. Lands before P4 so the demo video shows both.

acceptance.walkthrough:
RUNTIME: make stack-up, then http://127.0.0.1:3010 in Chrome (tailnet URL from make stack-status for a phone). The stack is left running in dev.

A (2 min) — /ask, press 「HLB 전환사채 공시가 몇 건이나 있나요?」. The sentence's chips 1 2 3 4 sit side by side after the period, no line break. Tap a chip: the quote floats over the text and nothing moves. Close by re-tap, Esc, or a click away.

B (5 min) — 「새 대화」, then the six cards one at a time, top-left to bottom-right. Expect six distinct tool rows: 이벤트 검색 · 이벤트 읽기 · 계산 · 내 포트폴리오 읽기 · 의견 저장 · 운영자 연락처. Card 3 draws a 검증된 계산 block with 「입력」 on the reader's 1,000주 and a 근거 chip on the 배정비율.

C (1 min) — in card 3's answer tap the 데이터 행 chip and the 계산 입력 chip: the quote opens under the row across the block, and the value column does not move.

D (1 min) — landing page, sparkle launcher, ask the HLB question in the widget, tap a chip: the quote stays inside the widget.

REAL VS NOT: every answer is the live agent reading real DART filings; nothing is stubbed. The one card with a side effect is the 의견 card — it writes a real row to /ops/feedback every press.

DECISIONS TO TAKE:
(1) Accept or reject the quote panel's OPAQUE GROUND — the phase's one deliberate deviation from R16, which signed --surface-inset. That token is rgba(255,255,255,.08) in the dark theme, so as an overlay the sentence read through the quote. The 2px --live edge and the 180px cap are unchanged and no new colour was introduced.
(2) MIJUAL_OPERATOR_CONTACT is unset, so the 연락처 card answers 「미정」 — honest and correct, but weak in the P4 video. Configure a contact string before P4, and which?
(3) The 인용 칩's target at 767 and below is 14x16px, not the 44px R16's prose lists under 「변경 없음」. R16's own CSS never implemented it either. Closing it breaks something signed either way: the primitive's media block would draw the 1px chip border as a 44px box around a 10px number, and an invisible hit expander on chips 3px apart would make each chip's target swallow its neighbour's — on the very multi-chip sentence this phase fixed. Close it and at what cost, or leave it as the round's CSS has it?
(4) /ops/feedback now holds SEVEN rows — ids 4-6 written by P11.S2's verification, id 7 by this review. The card files a row by design. Clear ids 4-7 before the P4 demo, or keep them as evidence the capability works?

FRESH-EYES FINDINGS (reported, not fixed, and deliberately not judged against the design record): the 의견 card looks identical to the five question cards yet is a statement in the reader's voice with a side effect; card 2 opens with a bare 14-digit 접수번호; at 390 a sentence's chips can land at the head of the next line, and a wrapped line can start with the signed 0.25em inter-sentence gap; an API-tier chip's popover is a 380x47 panel holding one link and can land over the 근거 footer; the footer's 「AI 질문」 link is 40x44 at 390 (pre-existing, filed as D30).

FILED AS DEFERRED: D28 (data-derived start-card set), D29 (의견 card indistinguishable), D30 (footer link target at 390).
